description: As a co-founder, I oversee sales and AI projects. Additionally, I am responsible for managing the integration of AI solutions into our business processes and ensuring the successful execution of AI-driven initiatives.

I am the manager of a project promoting internal DX in collaboration with a major television network. I lead a team of about seven people, handling customer negotiations and managing engineers. This role involves coordinating between the client and the engineering team to ensure the successful implementation of digital transformation initiatives within the company.
